# Zoran Krstić, Frontend Developer

> Zoran Krstić is a frontend developer specializing in React, Next.js and TypeScript, with growing full stack experience in databases, headless CMS and Stripe payments. He builds fast, accessible web apps with clean, maintainable code and is available for freelance projects and full-time positions.

Zoran works mostly with Next.js (App Router), TypeScript and Tailwind CSS, and connects them to headless CMS platforms (Strapi, Payload CMS, headless WordPress), databases (PostgreSQL, MariaDB with Prisma, MongoDB) and third-party services (Stripe, MailerLite, Resend, Upstash Redis, Cloudflare). He also has production experience with Nuxt 3 and Vue.

He focuses on performance (multi-layer caching, on-demand revalidation, 90+ PageSpeed scores) and accessibility (WCAG AA). Services: web application development, headless CMS sites, e-commerce and subscription payments with Stripe, marketing and SaaS websites, performance optimization and SEO.

## Client Projects

- [RankinWorld](https://rankinworld.com): data-driven country comparison platform with decades of global indicators and the StatGuessr daily guessing game; multi-layer caching (server, client, Cloudflare edge), on-demand revalidation, Strapi-powered blog (Next.js, TypeScript, Prisma, MariaDB, Strapi, Cloudflare)
- [Miriam's Joy](https://miriamsjoy.com/): artisan greeting card site with card subscriptions sold through Stripe, MailerLite newsletter, custom Strapi content blocks, 95+ mobile PageSpeed and WCAG AA (Next.js, Strapi, Stripe, MailerLite, Tailwind CSS)
- [Learn Plus](https://learn-plus.org/): accessible NGO website, migrated from Strapi to Payload CMS running inside the Next.js app, statically rendered with instant revalidation (Next.js, TypeScript, Payload CMS, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS)
- [Lypta](https://lypta-website.vercel.app/): SaaS marketing site with a Markdown blog, agency collaboration (Nuxt 3, Vue, Tailwind CSS)
- [Fakturify](https://www.fakturify.com/): SaaS invoicing marketing site, agency collaboration (Nuxt 3, Vue, Tailwind CSS)
- [Portage Creek Web Designs](https://portagecreekwebdesigns.com/): portfolio websites (Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Netlify)
- [Basketball Coach](https://probasketballcoach.com/): portfolio site for basketball coach Siniša Savović with a contact form (Next.js, SASS, Resend)
- [Rollo](https://rollo.hr/): PVC joinery company website with SEO (WordPress, Elementor)
- [Infiniwave](https://infiniwave-eight.vercel.app/): designer portfolio landing page, Figma to HTML/CSS/JS

## Personal Projects

- [Style Inspector](https://github.com/krsticzoran/style-inspector-extension): Chrome extension that shows an element's typography and colors on hover, without opening DevTools (vanilla JavaScript, Manifest V3, Shadow DOM, Chrome Storage API)
- [This portfolio](https://github.com/krsticzoran/my-portfolio): Next.js site with a contact form protected by schema validation, sanitization, honeypot, timing check and rate limiting, covered by Vitest unit tests (Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Zod, Resend, Upstash Redis, Vitest)
